info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Create Carrental Reservations Create-v2-spec
info.description: The Car Rental Reservation Creation API allows users to efficiently create multiple car rental reservations in a single request. Designed for travel agencies and platforms, this API streamlines the process of booking cars for clients, enhancing user experience and operational efficiency. By submitting reservation details such as customer information, pick-up and drop-off locations, and rental dates, users can manage and process bookings at scale. This API is essential for integrating car rental capabilities into applications and services, facilitating a seamless reservation experience.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new reservation in the system. It requires details such as the reservation date, time, and customer information. Upon successful creation, a confirmation of the reservation will be returned.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create a new reservation. It expects a JSON object containing all necessary details for the reservation, such as user information and reservation specifics.

200.description: The reservation has been successfully created.
